description: Schema changes to super-merchant: Add merchant_initiated, merchant_name, merchant_email columns to pending_approvals table to support merchant-initiated requests (where maker_id is null).
steps: 1. Modify /Users/mathew/super-merchant/src/main/java/com/tms/report/modules/checker/model/PendingApproval.java: (a) Add 'merchant_initiated' Boolean field with @Column(name = "merchant_initiated") and @Builder.Default private Boolean merchantInitiated = false; (b) Add 'merchant_name' String field with @Column(name = "merchant_name", length = 255); (c) Add 'merchant_email' String field with @Column(name = "merchant_email", length = 255); (d) Change maker @JoinColumn nullable to true: @JoinColumn(name = "maker_id", nullable = true). Add @JsonProperty annotations for snake_case JSON output.

2. Update /Users/mathew/super-merchant/src/main/resources/db/admin-schema.sql: Add ALTER TABLE statements after the existing pending_approvals column additions (around line 195) to add the three new columns: ALTER TABLE supermerchant.pending_approvals ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS merchant_initiated BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE; ALTER TABLE supermerchant.pending_approvals ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS merchant_name VARCHAR(255); ALTER TABLE supermerchant.pending_approvals ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS merchant_email VARCHAR(255);

3. Update /Users/mathew/super-merchant/src/main/java/com/tms/report/modules/approval/dto/SettlementConfigApprovalDto.java: Add three new fields with @JsonProperty: (a) @JsonProperty("merchant_initiated") private Boolean merchantInitiated; (b) @JsonProperty("merchant_name_from_request") private String merchantNameFromRequest; (c) @JsonProperty("merchant_email_from_request") private String merchantEmailFromRequest;

4. Modify /Users/mathew/super-merchant/src/main/java/com/tms/report/modules/checker/service/ApprovalService.java toSettlementDto() method: When building the DTO, if approval.getMerchantInitiated() == true, use approval.getMerchantName() and approval.getMerchantEmail() for makerName/makerEmail instead of approval.getMaker().getName()/getEmail(). Add the merchantInitiated, merchantNameFromRequest, and merchantEmailFromRequest fields to the builder. Handle null maker gracefully (maker can be null for merchant-initiated requests).
acceptance_criteria: PendingApproval entity compiles with new nullable maker_id and three new fields (merchant_initiated, merchant_name, merchant_email)
admin-schema.sql contains idempotent ALTER TABLE statements for the three new columns
SettlementConfigApprovalDto has the three new fields
ApprovalService.toSettlementDto() returns merchant_name/merchant_email as makerName/makerEmail when merchant_initiated=true
super-merchant project compiles: mvn compile -DskipTests passes
verification: Run `cd /Users/mathew/super-merchant && mvn spotless:apply -B && mvn spotless:check -B && mvn compile -B -DskipTests` to verify super-merchant compiles
findings: All schema changes applied successfully. The PendingApproval entity now supports merchant-initiated requests with nullable maker_id and three new fields (merchant_initiated, merchant_name, merchant_email). The toSettlementDto() method populates makerName/makerEmail from the merchant fields when merchantInitiated=true. Next features (FEAT-002) can now use these fields when creating approval requests from Merchant-Backend.
